# **MOHSIN JAVED**

**Software Engineer | Full-Stack Developer**

Lahore, Pakistan | +92 309 1948615 | mohsinjavedx@gmail.com
GitHub: github.com/Mohsin-Javed48 | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/mohsin-javed-b8a44641a | Portfolio: mohsin-javed.online


October 9, 2026


Hiring Team
Runtime Systems

hello@runtimesystems.tech


**Re: Application for Associate Full Stack Engineer (Remote, Pakistan)**


Dear Runtime Systems Hiring Team,


I am writing to apply for the Associate Full Stack Engineer position. Over the past 1.5 years at FrontendEx,

working fully remote, I have built and shipped production features across the whole stack: React and Next.js
interfaces, Node.js and NestJS APIs, and the PostgreSQL schemas underneath them. Along the way I have
taken four systems live. The role you describe, owning impactful features end to end alongside senior
engineers, is how I already work and how I want to keep growing.


Here is what I would bring to your team:


**Reliable back ends.** On an offline-first point-of-sale system, I built the server-side replay of sales queued
during network outages and made it exactly-once with a client-generated idempotency key backed by a

database unique constraint, so a sale can never be recorded twice. For a live fulfillment platform, I built
an asynchronous job queue for FedEx label generation that retries failed jobs automatically, backed by a
40+ action audit log.

**Practical, responsive front ends.** I built a config-driven, bilingual application wizard that serves six U.S.

states from one codebase, a role-based permission system with per-screen access, and a debounced
search that loads large school and city lists 50 records at a time instead of all at once.

**Debugging and performance across the stack.** I kept offline product search under 200ms across 1,000+
cached items, added a global interceptor so expired sessions are handled cleanly, and stopped manifest

re-imports from creating duplicate orders or overwriting shipments already in transit.


I also work with several of your nice-to-haves, including Redis, Docker, CI/CD workflows and AWS, and I use
Claude Code for AI-assisted development, which helps me move quickly while I still review and verify every
change. In a distributed team I rely on clear written communication, from pull request descriptions to stand
up updates, because that is often where the real collaboration happens.


I would welcome the chance to walk you through any of these projects in more detail. My code is at
github.com/Mohsin-Javed48 and my project write-ups are at mohsin-javed.online. Thank you for your time
and consideration.


Sincerely,
Mohsin Javed
